Polymer synthesis and testing

Our patented chemical process gives access to new polymer structures. We produce laboratory samples and test them against your specific requirements, linking the chemistry to the properties you need.

Physical samples make it possible to evaluate candidate polymers against a defined material brief.

Development timeframe
2–3 months

AI-driven polymer development

Share the requirements for your material. Synboli’s AI platform identifies promising structures, which are synthesised and tested in the laboratory. Experimental results refine the models, connecting prediction and evaluation through successive iterations.

AI selection and experimental testing work together, with each cycle informing the next.

Development timeframe
6–9 months

AI-driven domain exploration

For needs across an application domain or material portfolio, we build fine-tuned AI models supported by high-quality data. Synboli’s ability to generate data through proprietary synthesis helps extend discovery to a broader range of new polymers.

Application-specific models bring the search into focus across a wider portfolio of polymer opportunities.
